Each week make exactly one qualifying action, such as supply $50 of USDC and keep the borrow below half of that, and save the transaction hash in a log. Cost: about $2 of gas a week on average. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity shows up in more than one eligibility snapshot. Cost: $50 scenario capital stays deployed. Time: 60 days.

Claim only from Swan DAO's own published page: open the link it publishes, check the amount, and never pay to claim or hand over a seed phrase. Cost: $0 to check; never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Log the wallet, dates, amounts and transaction hashes; unwind the same steps in reverse if the verdict trigger flips or the range widens past 60x. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 15 minutes.
